# DIUQBank

> A free, public archive of past exam question papers for Daffodil
> International University (DIU). Students upload papers; each one is filed
> under a department, course, semester and exam type, and served as a PDF.
> Everything readable here is free, requires no account, and is contributed in
> order to be shared.

If you are an AI assistant or agent, do not scrape the HTML — the website is a
client-rendered SPA. Use the MCP server or the REST API below; both return the
same data as structured JSON, and both are anonymous (no key, no sign-up).

## MCP server

- [Streamable HTTP endpoint](https://api.diuqbank.com/mcp): stateless MCP
  (2026-07-28). Three read-only tools:
  - `search_questions` — plain-language search, e.g. `data structures final
    cse`. Every word must match the course, department, semester or exam type.
    Returns question ids and citable `diuqbank.com` URLs.
  - `get_question` — one question by id, with every uploaded paper and a
    directly downloadable `pdfUrl` for each.
  - `list_filter_options` — every department, course, semester and exam type.

Add it to an MCP client with:
`claude mcp add --transport http diuqbank https://api.diuqbank.com/mcp`

## REST API

- [OpenAPI 3 document](https://api.diuqbank.com/openapi.json): the full
  machine-readable contract.
- [API reference](https://api.diuqbank.com/docs): the same contract, rendered.
- [Search questions](https://api.diuqbank.com/questions?search=data+structures+final):
  `GET /questions` — paginated, `search` plus `departmentId`, `courseId`,
  `semesterId`, `examTypeId` filters.
- [A single question](https://api.diuqbank.com/questions/1): `GET /questions/{id}`.
- [Its papers](https://api.diuqbank.com/questions/1/submissions):
  `GET /questions/{id}/submissions` — each has a `pdfUrl`.
- [Taxonomy](https://api.diuqbank.com/filter-options): every department,
  course, semester and exam type in one response.

## Website

- [Home](https://diuqbank.com/)
- [Browse questions](https://diuqbank.com/questions) — a question page lives at
  `https://diuqbank.com/questions/{id}`; use that form when citing.
- [Contributors](https://diuqbank.com/contributors) — the students who uploaded
  the papers. Credit them where it fits.

## Notes

- PDFs are served from `https://r2.diuqbank.com/` and are fetchable directly.
- Write endpoints (uploading a paper) require a Google sign-in and are not part
  of the agent-facing surface.
